summary: Bank of Montreal filed a Form 6-K with exhibits including legal opinions from Sullivan & Cromwell LLP and Osler, Hoskin & Harcourt LLP in connection with the issuance of $3.25 billion aggregate principal amount of senior notes (4.547% due 2029, 4.879% due 2032, and 5.298% due 2037) under its existing shelf registration statement. This is a routine debt offering by a financial institution; no special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or restructuring is involved.
